salary_details.details: The MTS post carries Pay Level-01 in the Pay Matrix as per the 7th Central Pay Commission, with a pay range of ₹18,000 to ₹56,900 per month. In addition to pay, selected candidates are entitled to Dearness Allowance (DA), House Rent Allowance (HRA), Transport Allowance (TA), National Pension System (NPS), medical facilities/reimbursement, Leave Travel Concession (LTC), Children Education Allowance (CEA), and other benefits admissible under CSIR/Government of India rules.

how_to_apply: CSIR-NAL MTS applications are accepted only in physical hard-copy form; there is no apply online option for this recruitment.
Download and fill the prescribed application form neatly typed on A4-size paper (handwritten applications are not accepted).
Affix a recent self-attested passport-size colour photograph and sign the form in the designated space.
Pay the ₹500/- application fee through Demand Draft, wherever applicable, drawn in favour of the Director, CSIR-NAL, payable at Bengaluru.
Attach self-attested copies of all requisite certificates/documents along with the application.
Superscribe the envelope as "Application for the Post of MTS, Advt. No.11/2026."
Send the completed application by Speed Post/Courier only to reach the address below on or before 21.09.2026, 5.00 PM:
The Director, CSIR–National Aerospace Laboratories (CSIR–NAL), Post Bag No. 1779, HAL Airport Road, Kodihalli, Bengaluru – 560017, Karnataka.
Applications received after the closing date, through e-mail, hand delivery, or any mode other than Speed Post/Courier, or without the prescribed fee/documents, will be rejected.
important_instructions: Applicants must be citizens of India. Candidature is provisional and subject to verification of original documents; false or incorrect information will lead to cancellation at any stage, including after appointment. The post carries All India Service Liability (AISL); selected candidates may be posted/transferred to any CSIR Laboratory/Institute/Centre in India. Selected candidates will be on probation for two years from the date of joining. No TA will be reimbursed for appearing in the written examination. Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification. Any updates, corrigendum, or addendum will be posted only on the official CSIR-NAL website (www.nal.res.in); no individual notifications will be sent.

Candidates looking for other openings can also explore more Government Jobs in Karnataka and 10th Pass Government Jobs across India. Applicants searching for opportunities closer to Bengaluru can check Bengaluru Government Jobs for upcoming vacancies. content_sections.heading: CSIR-NAL MTS Recruitment 2026 Overview
content_sections.text: Here is a quick summary of the CSIR-NAL MTS Recruitment 2026 notification for candidates who want the key facts at a glance. Register for Job Alerts Applications sent by e-mail, hand delivery, or any mode other than Speed Post/Courier will not be entertained.

content_sections.heading: CSIR-NAL MTS Important Dates
content_sections.text: The cut-off date for determining eligibility with respect to age limit and educational qualification is the closing date prescribed for receipt of hard copies. CSIR-NAL will not be responsible for postal delays.

content_sections.heading: CSIR-NAL MTS Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 6 vacancies have been notified for the post of Multi-Tasking Staff under Advt. No. 11/2026. The category-wise break-up is as follows. The Competent Authority has the right to cancel the recruitment process at any stage for administrative reasons, and the number of vacancies indicated is provisional and may increase or decrease.

content_sections.heading: CSIR-NAL MTS Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: The essential qualification for the MTS post is SSC/10th Standard from a recognised Board or Institution. The prescribed qualifications are the minimum requirement; mere possession of the qualification does not entitle a candidate to be called for the written examination. Applicants must have attained 18 years of age and must not have exceeded the upper age limit of 25 years (for UR candidates) as on the last date prescribed for receipt of hard-copy applications. SC/ST/OBC(NCL) candidates who apply against Unreserved (UR) posts will not get age relaxation and will be treated at par with general candidates, though application fee exemption still applies to SC and ST candidates in such cases. To avoid any confusion regarding age eligibility, candidates can use our Age Calculator to calculate their exact age based on the prescribed cut-off date before applying.

content_sections.heading: CSIR-NAL MTS Salary
content_sections.text: The MTS post carries Pay Level-01 in the Pay Matrix as per the 7th Central Pay Commission, with a pay range of ₹18,000 to ₹56,900 per month. In addition to pay, selected candidates are entitled to Dearness Allowance (DA), House Rent Allowance (HRA), Transport Allowance (TA), National Pension System (NPS), medical facilities/reimbursement, Leave Travel Concession (LTC), Children Education Allowance (CEA), and other benefits admissible under CSIR/Government of India rules.

content_sections.heading: CSIR-NAL MTS Application Fee
content_sections.text: A non-refundable application fee of ₹500/- is payable only through a Demand Draft (DD) drawn in favour of "The Director, CSIR-National Aerospace Laboratories," payable at Bengaluru. The candidate's name and father's name must be written on the back of the DD. No other mode of payment is accepted. The application fee, once paid, is non-refundable and cannot be adjusted against any other recruitment process.

content_sections.heading: CSIR-NAL MTS Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is through an OMR-based Objective Type Multiple Choice Competitive Written Examination, conducted only in Bengaluru. Candidates fulfilling the eligibility criteria as screened by the Screening-cum-Selection Committee will be called for the exam, and a merit list will be prepared based on exam performance. Each correct answer carries 3 marks. In case of a tie in the merit list, it will be resolved in order by: fewer negative marks, older date of birth, earlier acquisition of the essential qualification, and finally alphabetical order of first names.

faq.question: Q1. What is CSIR-NAL MTS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a direct recruitment drive by CSIR-National Aerospace Laboratories, Bengaluru, under Advt. No. 11/2026, to fill 6 Multi-Tasking Staff (MTS) posts.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in CSIR-NAL MTS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 6 vacancies are notified: ST-01, OBC(NCL)-02, EWS-01, and UR-02.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for CSIR-NAL MTS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of hard-copy applications is 21.09.2026, up to 5.00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for CSIR-NAL MTS?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed SSC/10th Standard from a recognised Board.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for CSIR-NAL MTS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 25 years as on the closing date, with age relaxation applicable for reserved categories, PwBD, Ex-Servicemen, and certain women candidates as per Government norms.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for CSIR-NAL MTS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is ₹500/-, payable by Demand Draft only. SC, ST, Ex-Servicemen, PwBD, and women candidates are exempted from the fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for CSIR-NAL MTS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted only in physical hard-copy form via Speed Post/Courier to the CSIR-NAL address in Bengaluru; online, e-mail, and hand-delivered applications are not accepted.
